items.title: Jalen Coker: Salvages night with TD in loss
items.description:
Coker secured two of five targets for 37 yards and a touchdown in the Panthers' 27-19 loss to the Packers on Thursday. He also lost a fumble.

items.title: Jordan Love: Stays hot in Week 9 win
items.description:
Love completed 30 of 41 passes for 288 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and recovered a fumble in the Packers' 27-19 win over the Panthers on Thursday.

items.title: Christian Watson: Suffers broken rib Thursday
